posts.title: Do we have a moral obligation to improve software with AI?
posts.description: I wrote one of the first native JavaScript spellcheckers, Typo.js, fifteen years ago. At the time, it was really only useful within a browser extension, since webpages didn’t offer all of the JavaScript features it needed. (I originally used it to get YouTube Comment Snob working in Chrome, which didn’t have Firefox’s native spellchecker API.) […]

posts.title: I replaced the unused space under my stairs with big drawers, and it only took me seven months.
